data.description: The profile of the ratio of solvents in the mobile phase used over the course of a chromatographic separation. Use notation whereby relative proportions of the eluents at a specific time point are separated by “/”, e.g. “10/90 at 1 min”. Different time points are separated by a comma. Include re-equilibration times. Example: '0/100 at 0 min, 100/0 at 6 min, 0/100 at 7 min, 0/100 at 10 min'

ontology.name: obi
ontology.description: Part of an NMR instrument that detects the signals emitted from a sample. No single probe can perform the full range of experiments, and probes that are designed to perform more than one type of measurement usually suffer from performance compromises. The probe represents a rather fragile single point of failure that can render an NMR system completely unusable if the probe is dropped or otherwise damaged. Probes are usually characterised by Sample diameter and Frequency.n alt The instrument that transmits and receives radiofrequency to and from the NMR sample.
